task: Find the course on Coursera named 'Essentials of Global Health'. Determine the instructor of this course and summarize his bio, note if there are any additional courses he offers on Coursera.
answer: The course 'Essentials of Global Health' on Coursera (offered by Yale University) is taught by Richard Skolnik. Bio summary: Richard Skolnik has more than 40 years of experience in international development and global health and is the author of the widely used textbook Global Health 101 (3rd edition). He spent 25 years at the World Bank, retiring as Director for Health and Education for the South Asia Region, with health work across Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and South Asia focused on health financing, equity, maternal/child health, and communicable diseases. He was VP for International Programs at the Population Reference Bureau (PRB), Director of the Center for Global Health at The George Washington University (teaching there for 8 years), and Executive Director of the Harvard PEPFAR AIDS treatment program in Botswana, Nigeria, and Tanzania. He served on the Global Fund Technical Review Panel and WHO advisory groups, and helped establish STOP TB. He lectured for five years at the Yale School of Public Health and Yale School of Management. He holds a BA from Yale University and an MPA from Princeton's Woodrow Wilson School, and is from Dayton, Ohio. Additional courses: Richard Skolnik's Coursera instructor profile lists no additional courses; 'Essentials of Global Health' is the only course he offers on Coursera.
